desc:
If a storm subdued still has the power to save a certain person... The ringing of the old sword in its crate speaks of the "good" old days that one doesn't want to remember.

<color=#959595>"Nekomata, put it down. No, there's no secret... Nicole, please let me explain, she was the one who started it..." — Anby, just a typical day with the Cunning Hares.</color>
desc2: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: The sheen of silver is not innocence. Can the blades of the past cut through fate's connections?
name: Severed Innocence

1.desc: CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When the equipper lands a hit with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1.name: Tranquil Blossom
